selection_statement: No external source audited here satisfies the full uncalibrated transmitter-inventory, receiver-measurement, legal, and reproducibility contract for A.T.O.M. Therefore no benchmark is selected and no dataset adapter is implemented.

best_near_candidate.reason: It has the strongest public combination of raw RSRP/RSRQ/SINR, serving identifiers, a base-station table, antenna height/angle/tilt, bandwidth, power field, and environmental products.
not_selected_because: raw ARFCN and base downlink/frequency values do not reconcile without a documented rule
power reference plane is not established as conducted output or EIRP
absolute antenna gain/pattern and receiver height/calibration are not supplied
some serving observations do not map to the base table
neighbor/resource/noise semantics are insufficient for radio-quality validation

complementary_near_candidate.reason: It provides the strongest measurement and environment context, including exact LTE B7/2.6 observations, but the public transmitter deployment is inferred and lacks absolute RF configuration.
complementary_near_candidate.permitted_future_scope: LTE B7/2.6 quantity and relative propagation analysis, with inferred deployment fields explicitly labeled and no absolute power claim.

not_a_selection.lacn_n79_uav: Geometry/tilt contrast only; n79/4.9 GHz, local coordinates, missing power/gain/pattern, no license found.
not_a_selection.taltech_mmwave_n258: Restricted files; inaccessible raw-data stop condition.
not_a_selection.mendeley_campus_5g: Calibrated transmitter parameters are not independent benchmark truth.

may_claim_now: The audited sources and their public metadata have the documented strengths and blockers in the matrix.
Chongqing and Vienna are conditional research candidates for future quantity/relative propagation work.
Existing 6A and 6A.1 remain unvalidated for real measurements.
must_not_claim: A.T.O.M. has been calibrated or validated against external real-world data.
Any candidate reconstructs a complete canonical transmitter inventory.
A shortlist entry is production-ready or opens the 6B gate.
Measured RSRP/RSRQ/SINR is interchangeable with received power, path loss, or radio quality.
